title: Code, prompts, data and results for: Safety Rules, Algorithm Prompts and Guideline Retrieval for Local Language Models in Emergency Triage
description: Code, prompts, data and results for an ablation study of the JeevanSetu triage pipeline: fixed safety rules with a hard override, a summary of the Emergency Severity Index (ESI) algorithm in the prompt, and guideline retrieval, tested with open-weight language models run locally through Ollama on 207 visits from the MIMIC-IV-ED demo dataset, against the triage nurse's ESI level. The code is under the MIT licence. The MIMIC-IV-ED Demo and MIMIC-IV Demo files and the run results derived from them are under the Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0. ESI handbook text is withheld from the retrieval caches; the README explains how to restore it from a purchased copy.
